latency.note: One-way estimates in ms, sampled every 8s from each client. The Zoom delay assumes the socket path beats the call audio; if median latency approaches the delay setting, that assumption is failing.

anticipation.note: Buzzes under 150ms are players timing the read, not reacting to the lights.
